defs.def: to produce letters, pictures, etc. on paper using a machine that puts ink on the surface 在纸上印；打印

ex.s: The benefits of print reading particularly shine through when experimenters move from posing simple tasks — like identifying the main idea in a reading passage — to ones that require mental abstraction — such as drawing inferences from a text.
ex.t: 当实验者从简单任务——比如找出一段阅读材料的主旨——转向需要心智抽象的任务——比如从文本中做推断——时，纸质阅读的优势尤为明显。

ex.s: Print texts cannot be entirely replaced in education.
ex.t: 纸质文本在教育中无法被完全取代。

ex.s: Then you can print out a fresh draft, again setting your text on triple-space.
ex.t: 然后你可以打印一份新草稿，再次将文本设为三倍行距。

ex.s: Finally, click "print" and "OK".
ex.t: 最后，单击“打印”和“确定”。

ex.s: Don’t forget to check in online and print your boarding pass in advance.
ex.t: 别忘了在线办理登机手续，并提前打印您的登机牌。

ex.s: There's a new frontier in 3D printing that's beginning to come into focus： food． Recent development has made possible machines that print， cook， and serve foods on a mass scale． And the industry isn't stopping there．
ex.t: 3D打印出现了一个新的前沿领域，正开始受到关注：食品。近期的发展使能够大规模打印、烹饪并供应食物的机器成为可能。而该行业并未止步于此。

ex.s: （1）What benefit does 3D printing bring to food production？
ex.t: （1）3D打印给食品生产带来了什么好处？

ex.s: （2）What can we learn about 3D food printing from Paragraph 3？
ex.t: （2）从第3段关于3D食物打印能了解到什么？

ex.s: （4）What is the main factor that prevents 3D food printing from spreading widely？
ex.t: （4）阻止3D食品打印技术广泛传播的主要因素是什么？

ex.s: The printing process is complicated．
ex.t: D．一些专家质疑3D食品打印。

ex.s: Some experts doubt 3D food printing．
ex.t: D． 一些专家怀疑3D食品打印。

ex.s: 3D Food Printing： Delicious New Technology
ex.t: A．3D食物打印：美味新技术

ex.s: Riders have printed nearly 20,000 short stories and poems since the program was launched last March.
ex.t: 自去年3月该项目启动以来，乘客已打印了近两万篇短篇故事和诗歌。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: （3）According to Paragraph 4，3D﹣printed food     ．
ex.t: （3）根据第4段，3D打印食物____。

ex.s: Using an old 3D printer, Mark started experimenting.
ex.t: 用一台旧3D打印机，Mark开始了尝试。

ex.s: A New Way to Improve 3D Food Printing
ex.t: B．改进3D食物打印的新方法

ex.s: 3D Food Printing： From Farm to Table
ex.t: D．3D食物打印：从农场到餐桌

ex.s: What is the function of the sensors printed on plant leaves by MIT engineer?
ex.t: 麻省理工学院工程师打印在植物叶子上的传感器有什么功能？

ex.s: Future 3D food printers could make processed food healthier． Hod Lipson， a professor at Columbia University， said， "Food printing could allow consumer to print food with customized nutritional content， like vitamins． So instead of eating a piece of yesterday 's bread from the supermarket， you'd eat something baked just for you on demand．"
ex.t: 未来的3D食品打印机可以让加工食品更健康。哥伦比亚大学教授霍德·利普森说：“食品打印可以让消费者打印出具有定制营养含量的食物，比如维生素。所以，你不必吃超市里昨天烤的面包，而是可以随时吃到专门为你现烤的食物。”

ex.s: I always wanted to know what my mom was reading． Hearing mom say，"I can't believe what's printed in the newspaper this morning，" made me want to grab it out of her hands and read it myself． I wanted to be like my mom and know all of the things she knew． So I carried around a book， and each night， just to be like her， I would pretend to be reading．
ex.t: 我一直想知道妈妈在读什么。听到妈妈说“真不敢相信今天早上报纸上印了什么”，我就想从她手里抢过报纸自己读。我想成为像妈妈那样的人，知道她知道的所有事情。于是我随身带着一本书，每天晚上，就为了像她一样，我还会假装在阅读。

ex.s: These include plants that have sensors printed onto their leaves to show when they’re short of water and a plant that can detect harmful chemicals in groundwater. ＂We’re thinking about how we can engineer plants to replace functions of the things that we use every day,＂explained Michael Strano, a professor of chemical engineering at MIT.
ex.t: 这些包括叶子上印有传感器、能显示植物何时缺水的植物，以及一种能检测地下水中有害化学物质的植物。“我们正在思考如何改造植物，以取代我们日常使用物品的功能，”麻省理工学院化学工程教授Michael Strano解释道。

defs.def: to produce books, newspapers, etc. by printing them in large quantities 印刷

ex.s: The Machine Stops Instead of being printed, the Earth Chronicle is every morning spoken to subscribers, who, in interesting conversations with reporters, statesmen, and scientists, learn the news of the day.
ex.t: 《机器停止》：地球纪事不再印刷，而是每天早上通过有趣的对话向订阅者播报，订阅者通过与记者、政治家和科学家的交流了解当天的新闻。

ex.s: Before the wide use of the printing press, books were treasured objects and could be works of art in their own right.
ex.t: 在印刷术广泛使用之前，书籍是珍贵的物品，其本身就可以是艺术品。

ex.s: Think of the four great inventions in Ancient China: gunpowder, papermaking, printing and the compass.
ex.t: 想想中国古代的四大发明：火药、造纸、印刷和指南针。

ex.s: Yes, we all have our phones, but many of us still like to go old school and read something printed.
ex.t: 是的，我们都有手机，但我们中的许多人仍然喜欢老派一点，读点印刷品。

ex.s: Continued developments in communication technologies were once believed to make the printed page outdated.
ex.t: 通信技术的不断发展曾让人们以为印刷书页将会过时。

ex.s: From a 21st-century point of view, the printed book is certainly ancient, but it remains as interactive as any battery-powered e-reader.
ex.t: 从21世纪的角度看，印刷书固然古老，但它仍像任何电池供电的电子阅读器一样具有互动性。

ex.s: And in contrast to our increasingly networked lives where the information we consume is monitored and tracked, a printed book still offers the chance of a wholly private, “off-line” activity.
ex.t: 与我们日益网络化的生活——我们所消费的信息被监控和追踪——形成对比的是，印刷书仍提供一种完全私密、"离线"活动的机会。

ex.s: The printed book is not totally out of date.
ex.t: 印刷书并没有完全过时。

to produce a photograph from a film 洗印；冲洗
to write without joining the letters together 用印刷体写（字母之间笔画不相连接）

ex.s: At first, everything went wrong — the plastic broke, the printer jammed, and the pieces didn’t fit together.
ex.t: 几周后，我又去了农场。

ex.s: The differences between print and digital reading results are partly related to paper’s physical properties.
ex.t: 印刷和数字阅读结果之间的差异部分与纸张的物理特性有关。

defs.def: to make a mark on a soft surface by pressing （在松软的表面）压印，印出
to make a design on a surface or cloth by pressing a surface against it which has been coloured with ink or dye 印（图案）；印染

ex.s: According to this theory, people approach digital texts with a mindset suited to social media, which are often not so serious, and devote less mental effort than when they are reading print.
ex.t: 根据这一理论，人们以一种适合社交媒体的心态对待电子文本——往往不那么严肃，投入的脑力也比读纸质文本时少。

ex.s: Just a specially printed piece of paper and hemp that we've assigned value to — and probably less durable over time than those shells.
ex.t: 只是一张特别印制的纸和我们赋予价值的麻纤维——而且随着时间的推移可能还不如那些贝壳耐用。

defs.def: letters, words, numbers, etc. that have been printed onto paper 印刷字体

ex.s: Digital texts, audio and video all have educational roles, especially when providing resources not available in print.
ex.t: 电子文本、音频和视频都有其教育作用，尤其是在提供纸质材料无法获得的资源时。

defs.def: used to refer to the business of producing newspapers, magazines and books 印刷行业；出版界

ex.s: Choosing a print publisher.
ex.t: 选择一家印刷出版商。

a picture that is cut into wood or metal then covered with ink and printed onto paper; a picture that is copied from a painting using photography 版画；（用照相制版法制作的）绘画复制品
a photograph produced from film （用底片洗印的）相片
cotton cloth that has a pattern printed on it; this pattern 印花棉布（或图案）；花样
still available from the company that publishes it 书籍
